title: Connector Hub connector definition (CN-01)
description: One file per connector in a connector directory. `settings` is validated by the bound auth type handler's definitionSchema. Provider client IDs/secrets are env var NAMES in `env`, never values (CN-02).

id.description: Stable id; a later connector directory overrides the same id

env.description: Handler input -> env var name (e.g. clientId -> HUBSPOT_CLIENT_ID). Missing env skips the connector with a log line.

settings.description: Auth-type-specific settings (endpoints, scopes, PKCE, refresh, revoke)

credentialFields.description: Fields the user enters for non-OAuth auth types

baseUrl.description: Provider API base: fixed, or taken from a credential field (per connection)

test.description: Credential test request (VA-03), relative to baseUrl. Header values may use {{accessToken}}, {{apiKey}}, {{username}}, {{basic}}.

accountIdPath.description: Dot path in the JSON response to the provider account id

auth.description: How apps send the issued secret to the provider (returned by POST /v1/credentials)
